title: WIBTA if I just throw away a confederate flag that has been in my family since just after the civil war?
question: WIBTA if I just throw away a confederate flag that has been in my family since just after the civil war?
body:
Background: I don’t know the exact generation but a great grandfather was in the civil war for the losing side. His cousin was also in the war but for the north. After the war thier grandmother commissioned a photograph of the two of them together with what was left of their unforms and an American flag and a weird version of the confederate flag she had made (it has the flag we know as the kkk flag in the corner and the rest is white and red). My dad still has the picture and he still had the flag. As an aside he took it on pawn stars though the segment was never aired and the historian guy verified that the flag my dad had was the flag in the picture. 

My dad is in hospice and doesn’t have very much but everything he does have will go to me. The first thing I want to do is pitch the picture and the flag. I’m not a racist nor a magaite and I want nothing to do with garbage and racism, and I don’t want my kids to have to worry about this trash as well.

My cousin is about to have a hissy fit and thinks I should give it to me. I saw no, it’s appropriate place is at the bottom of a landfill. 

This is pretty simple as I see it, but just in case, would I be the asshole?
